summary.headline: SaVida Health locks in $358K of hard annual savings by renegotiating its EMR contract
summary.narrative: In less than seven months, Treya Partners helped SaVida Health renegotiate its contract with incumbent EMR provider Athena, dropping the fee from 4.56 % to 3.40 %. The new three-year agreement delivers $357,889 in verified annual run-rate savings—22 % off prior costs—while preserving service continuity and limiting future price escalation. Additional categories remain in flight, but this early win already covers 84 % of the project’s original savings target range.

impact.operational_improvements: Secured a three-year EMR contract with defined CPI cap, eliminating embedded credit-card fees and improving fee transparency. Established process for centralized contract review and spend visibility, setting the stage for further GPO and telecom savings.

proof_points.statement: Negotiated Athena fee reduction from 4.56 % to 3.40 %, yielding $357,889 in annual savings (22 %).
